objective: Validate the Result Contract v2 timeline and validator-owned evidence flow on the real local dsh-vision checkout while preserving legacy Result Contract v1 compatibility.
context: The project workflow is synced to Ran-sh/chatgpt_workflow@c38d94c48ebb1c48cff2eeba685dea69667f9998. This is a focused workflow E2E only: prove that a new Result Contract uses schema_version 2, records second-precision timezone-aware started/completed timestamps, is stamped by the installed result validator, and that the previous DSH-VISION-WORKFLOW-E2E-001 legacy v1 result still validates. Do not modify product code.
forbidden_changes: credentials, secrets, local DSH configuration, and unrelated files
acceptance_criteria: The Task Contract validates successfully before execution.
source_commit LATEST resolves to the current tip of main after pull/fetch and the exact source SHA used is recorded in the new Result Contract.
The historical DSH-VISION-WORKFLOW-E2E-001 Result Contract validates successfully as legacy v1 without being rewritten.
The new Result Contract contains schema_version 2.
The new Result Contract records timeline.started_at and timeline.completed_at using ISO 8601 year-month-day hour:minute:second with timezone and no milliseconds.
Every listed validation command is actually executed and reported with one of PASS, FAIL, PARTIAL, SKIP, BLOCKED, or NOT RUN.
After timeline.completed_at is final, run node .agent-workflow/validator/validate-contract.mjs result docs/agent-results/DSH-VISION-RESULT-V2-E2E-002-result.json --stamp.
The installed validator writes result_validation.status PASS, validator command, result_validation.validated_at to second precision with timezone, and success evidence into the new Result Contract.
result_validation.validated_at is not earlier than timeline.completed_at.
No product source, tests, scripts, CI, package/version metadata, credentials, or unrelated files are modified.
On completion, ACTIVE_TASK.json is deleted and only the Result Contract plus task deletion are committed/pushed.
